style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: he never stops: at a full sidewinding sprint from the first frame, coils pumping like a piston, the camera racing backwards ahead of him so the bill walls tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; loose bills wipe the lens every beat; his head fills half the frame height, head-on and closer from 8.2; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a thick olive python in a grey collector waistcoat, flat yellow eyes, deadpan face
second_characters: ONE lean grey rat in a red visor sprinting at the lens all clip, flinging bills
props: overdue bill sheets the rat flings, each with a big red circular stamp and a column of digits; loose bills gusting past his coils; a paper maw folded out of those same bills, crease teeth top and bottom
prop_continuity: the bills keep flying until the maw folds shut; the red stamp stays readable; the maw is built only from the bills the rat himself flings; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a narrow corridor, bricks of red stamped bills filling both walls to the ceiling, red then orange then violet

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.0 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.0-1.5 one breath; pause 1.5-2.8; 2.8-4.4 one breath; pause 4.4-5.4; 5.4-9.0 one breath; after 9.0 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: scales hissing over stone all clip, paper storm, a wet gulp at 1.4, a dry crease snap at 4.6, a rustling swallow at 7.0

timeline.a: the frame opens on him already at a full sprint, coils pumping, red bill walls tearing past, the rat sprinting in at his jaw flinging bills
he snaps a flung bill out of the air in his jaws at full drive and it is gone in one gulp
the rat flings in a whole brick of bills and he takes it whole without slowing, his throat swelling past the lens
the brick shaped bulge rockets head to tail down his body, orange walls tearing past
his tail whips a wall stack and it bursts into a blizzard of bills, all of it streaking backwards past him
head on to the lens, still driving hard, bills wiping the lens
the loose bills fold and lock into a paper maw with crease teeth and it drops in behind the sprinting rat
the maw snaps twice at the rat heels while he sprints at the lens flinging more bills into it
the maw swells on the bills the rat feeds it, now the rat own height, tearing along behind him past violet walls
the maw takes the rat whole from behind at a full run and the paper creases shut over him
a rat shaped bulge sprints on inside the paper level with the python, the legs still pumping, bills still flying out of it
his head fills the frame head on, still driving hard, the paper rat pumping along beside him
the paper rat sprints out ahead past the lens, he drives after it, the walls tearing past

must_appear: the maw is folded from the bills the rat flings; at 6.4 it takes the rat from behind; from 7.2 a rat shaped bulge keeps sprinting inside the paper with the legs pumping
negative_prompt: speech bubble, comic panel, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, a parked camera, a still background, a stopped snake, a snake in ambush, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a hero moving away from the lens, a held pose, slow motion, cyrillic letters, speech after 9.0
